import aiinfo = require("@instructure.ai/aiinfo");

const uid: keyof typeof aiinfo.default = "smartsearch";
const name: string = aiinfo.nutritionFacts[uid].featureName;
const permission: string = aiinfo.dataPermissionLevels[uid].currentFeature;
const data: typeof aiinfo.default.smartsearch.aiInformation = aiinfo.aiInformation[uid];
console.log(name, permission, data);
